summary:
Final item of the run, and the last genuine gap in the knowledge record rather than filler: the batching apply path that I read early on and had only ever referenced as a limitation of other statements (valid:true).

Behaviour recorded: with an FSM that implements `BatchingFSM`, the apply loop sends only command and configuration entries to `ApplyBatch`, in commit order and without gaps; no-ops and barriers are excluded from the batch but still advance the batch's index and term bookkeeping, so the FSM thread's reported index covers the whole batch. Responses map back one per sent log in order, every queued future in the batch is answered in input order, an entry that was not sent yields a nil response, and a response count that does not match the number of sent logs panics rather than being silently truncated — while without `BatchingFSM` the same loop applies entries one at a time (fsm.go:127-186, contrasting the single-apply path at fsm.go:92-125).

That closes the record I set out to keep: every path I read and relied on in this run now exists as a behaviour or fact with sources, conditions and stated limits, alongside the three receipt-backed defects, the one conditional finding, and the negative results.

The run's time budget is exhausted after this update, so I am stopping here rather than continuing to spend it on marginal work: no new claim is being manufactured to fill the interval, and the retained drafts and receipts remain as recorded.
